name: PocketPlay
tagline: Move players on a football field and an ML model predicts how the play turns out.

awards: Third Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge

problem: Football play simulation tools are scarce.
solution: Coach and NFL modes let users position offensive and defensive markers; a trained model predicts outcomes; sign-in via Auth0.
demo_moment: Team-described: arrange a play and see the predicted result.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Beginner Hack (Software)” and “Third Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge” among 176 submissions.
A beginner team that also placed in an HPC challenge.

lessons: Beginners can win with a niche they care about.
